title: Business Development Executive
salary_text: £30000 - £35000 per year (Phone, Laptop, Car Allowance, Bonus)
description:
We are currently seeking an ambitious and commercially focused Business Development Executive to help drive business growth across our Construction & Highways operations.

This is a customer-facing role responsible for developing new business opportunities, strengthening existing client relationships and delivering profitable growth. Working closely with our Commercial, Operations and Transport teams, you will identify customer requirements, prepare quotations and proposals, and ensure a smooth transition from sale to delivery.

The role combines field-based customer engagement with office-based sales activity and would suit someone who enjoys building relationships, identifying opportunities and achieving measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and grow relationships with existing customers while identifying and securing new business opportunities.

Maintain regular contact with clients through meetings, site visits and telephone communication.

Qualify customer requirements and prepare accurate quotations, estimates and proposals.

Follow up quotations and proposals to maximise conversion opportunities.

Work closely with operational teams to coordinate resources and ensure successful project delivery.

Identify and target prospective customers within key market sectors.

Maintain accurate customer records and sales information within company systems.

Analyse customer activity and sales performance against targets.

Produce weekly and monthly sales reports.

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and business development planning.

Promote and uphold the company's health, safety and quality standards.

What We're Looking For

Essential

Previous sales or business development experience.

Strong customer relationship management skills.

Excellent communication and presentation abilities.

Ability to identify opportunities and convert them into business.

Strong organisational and time management skills.

Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications.

A proactive and self-motivated approach.

Desirable
- Experience within construction, highways, civil engineering industries.
- Familiarity with project planning or project management.
- Experience analysing sales or business data.
- Knowledge of road planing or surfacing operations.

If this sounds like you hit the apply button.

description:
Internal Sales Executive

Location: Worcester
Salary: 30,000 - 35,000 + Bonus + Excellent Benefits

The Opportunity

An established engineering manufacturer specialising in bespoke high-pressure pumping, vacuum and compressor solutions is seeking an Internal Sales Executive to join its growing commercial team. Supplying engineered solutions across a range of sectors including manufacturing, chemical processing, automotive, construction and industrial applications, this is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a career within technical sales and business development.

Key Responsibilities
- Generate and follow up on sales leads through outbound calls, emails and market research.
- Identify potential customers, projects and new business opportunities within target sectors.
- Qualify customer enquiries and gather information on project requirements, scope and timelines.
- Maintain accurate customer, prospect and opportunity records within the CRM system.
- Support the external sales team with customer enquiries, technical information and lead handovers.
- Monitor and progress opportunities through the sales pipeline.
- Research market trends, competitors and industry developments.
- Prepare sales reports, pipeline updates and business development data for management.
- Assist with quotations, proposals and customer communications.
- Support exhibitions, marketing campaigns and lead generation activities.

About You

We are interested in speaking with individuals who possess:
- A degree in Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent technical qualification.
- 2-5 years' experience within engineering, technical sales, business development, marketing or a similar commercial environment.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Confidence engaging with customers via telephone and email.
- Excellent organisational and administrative abilities.
- Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

Salary & Benefits
- 30,000 - 35,000 basic salary
- Performance-related profit bonus
- 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays
- 5% matched pension contribution
- Full sick pay scheme
- Income protection cover
- Early finish on Fridays
- Excellent long-term stability and career development opportunities within a growing engineering business.

If you are interested in this position please click 'apply'.

title: Contact Centre Manager
description:
Contact Centre Manager

38-42k, Office based

Their customer contact centre is at the heart of how customers experience our client, from their first question to their finished product. We're looking for a hands-on leader to run it, raise the bar on service and sales, and make the most of AI and our digital channels.

The role

You'll lead a multi-channel contact centre of around 14 people across phone, live chat, text and email, reporting to our Director of Customer Experience. Leading a team of Supervisors, you'll own service levels, sales conversion, customer satisfaction and the day-to-day running of the team.

This is a role for someone who leads from the floor, knows their numbers, and is excited by what AI can do for customers and advisors. You'll have real influence over how we work, the tools we use and how we develop our people.

What you'll do
- Lead, coach and develop Supervisors and their teams
- Own answer rates, chat response times, quality and customer satisfaction
- Drive sales conversion and run our advisor commission scheme
- Act as the senior escalation point for complaints and difficult cases
- Plan rotas and staffing for seasonal peaks
- Run a quality framework covering call and chat monitoring, coaching and feedback
- Manage our 8x 8 contact centre platform, including queues, routing, wallboards and reporting
- Lead our use of AI in the contact centre, from our AI chat advisor to agent assist and automated quality checks, making sure it improves the customer experience
- Report on performance and turn data into clear actions
- Work with delivery, installation, quality and marketing teams to fix the reasons customers need to contact us

What you'll bring
- Experience managing a contact centre team of 10 or more, including supervisors or team leaders
- A track record in both sales and service
- Confidence running a team on KPIs and workforce planning
- A fair, firm approach to people management
- Experience of 8x 8 or a similar cloud contact centre platform
- Hands-on experience of AI in a customer contact setting, such as chatbots or virtual agents, agent assist, automated quality monitoring or AI-driven reporting, and the curiosity to find new ways AI can improve the customer experience and free advisors up for higher-value conversations
- Strong reporting and Excel skills

It would be great if you also have
- Experience implementing or improving an AI chatbot or virtual agent
- A background in e-commerce or high-value consumer products
- Working knowledge of UK consumer rights

title: Contact Centre Supervisor
description:
Our client is a well established, market leading manufacturer that supplies to wholesalers and direct consumers.

Their contact centre helps customers choose the right products, place their order and get support right through to delivery and beyond. We're looking for a Supervisor who loves a busy floor, gets the best out of people and is as passionate about sales as they are about service.

The role

Reporting to our Contact Centre Manager, you'll lead a team of advisors across phone, live chat, text and email. You'll make sure customers get a quick, helpful answer every time, help the team turn conversations into sales, and keep the day running smoothly.

You'll be working with our Holly AI Advisor, our AI chat assistant, which handles routine questions so advisors can focus on higher-value conversations. You'll help shape how AI and people work together to give customers a better experience.

What you'll do
- Lead, motivate and support a team of advisors day to day, on the floor and hands-on
- Manage queues in real time to hit answer rates and chat response times, moving people where they're needed
- Coach advisors to grow sales, including on higher-value products
- Monitor calls and chats, give clear feedback and run regular one-to-ones
- Handle escalated calls and complaints, putting things right for customers fairly and quickly
- Manage attendance, holidays and absence, and help plan cover for seasonal peaks
- Use 8x 8 wallboards and reporting to track performance and spot issues early
- Train new starters and keep product and process knowledge up to date
- Help improve our AI chat advisor by spotting gaps and feeding back on what customers ask
- Work with delivery, after sales and quality teams to resolve problems and stop them happening again

What you'll bring
- Experience as a supervisor or team leader in a contact centre, or a strong advisor ready to step up
- A track record in sales, ideally with targets or commission
- A calm, confident approach to complaints and difficult conversations
- A fair, firm and supportive style of managing people
- Good knowledge of contact centre KPIs and real-time queue management
- Confidence with Excel and reporting
- Comfort with technology, and an interest in how AI can help customers and advisors

It would be great if you also have
- Experience of 8x 8 or a similar cloud contact centre platform
- Experience working alongside a chatbot or virtual agent
- A background in e-commerce, home and garden or high-value consumer products
- Working knowledge of UK consumer rights
